verdict.rationale: Devin's Knowledge feature is documented as a collection of instructions and advice it can reference in all sessions, so cross-session recall is covered. AGENTS.md support and MCP access to knowledge add further persistent context. Nothing in the pack shows Devin building or updating that memory on its own; Knowledge and AGENTS.md read as user-curated. Missing for 10: evidence that Devin automatically creates or updates memories from its sessions, detail on how recall is triggered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
